SubSprGfx1Hlpr1.name: Draw two stacked tiles for sprite
summary: Fills the second pair of OAM slots (index + 8) with two vertically stacked tiles from SprTilemap, 16 pixels apart.
Then jumps into the shared drawing code at CODE_019DA9. Returns via that code.

KoopaWingDispXLo.name: Table: Koopa wing X offsets low

KoopaWingDispXHi.name: Table: Koopa wing X offsets high

KoopaWingGfxRt.name: Draw Koopa wings
summary: $019E28: draws one wing as one OAM tile. Frame [$02] is 0 on the ground, else [$1602] AND 1; table index = direction * 2 + frame.
Returns early when offscreen vertically; the OAM X is stored before the horizontal offscreen check.
$019E95: entry that draws both wings: shifts the sprite by (-2,+2), draws the dir 0 wing, moves X by +4, draws the dir 1 wing
with the same frame ([$1570] >> 3 AND 1), using the next two OAM slots, then restores position, OAM index and direction.

SubSprGfx2Entry0.name: Draw 16x16 sprite, extra property in A
summary: Stores A in [$04] (extra OAM property bits, for example $80 for Y flip) and joins SubSprGfx2Entry1.

SubSprGfx2Entry1.name: Draw single 16x16 tile sprite
summary: Draws a sprite as one 16x16 OAM tile: tile = SprTilemap[[$1602] + SprTilemapOffset[sprite number]], position from GetDrawInfoBnk1,
property = palette | X flip when direction is 0 | [$04] | [$64]. Hides it via CODE_01A3DF when offscreen vertically.
Parameters: [$04] set by the entry (0 here).

s019F5B.name: Table: carried sprite X offset from Mario
summary: Two 6-byte tables (low bytes, then high bytes) indexed by pose: 0 right, 1 left, 2-4 Mario facing the camera, 5 pipe/turning/climbing.

ShellSpeedX.name: Table: kick X speeds
summary: Also includes DATA_019F67/019F69 above (sprite X offset when dropped: -13/+13). Index: 0 left, 1 right, +2 when on Yoshi. $019F6F: two unused bytes.

HandleSprCarried.name: Handle sprite carried by Mario
summary: Called for sprites with status $0B. Runs CODE_019F9B (balloon timer, release, collisions), hides the sprite in OAM when Mario turns, is in a pipe
or faces the camera, then draws it via CODE_01A187 (property forced to $10 in a pipe).
Parameters: X = sprite index. Preserves X and [RAM_SpriteProp].

s019F99.name: Table: drop X speed relative to Mario
summary: Index by Mario direction: -4 (left), +4 (right).

s019F9B.name: Carried sprite: balloon and release checks
summary: First part of HandleSprCarried. For the P-balloon (sprite $7D) counts down [$1891] every 4 frames and sets the warning pose in [$13F3].
A Mario animation kills the balloon. Other sprites continue at NotCarryingBalloon.

BalloonExpired.name: P-balloon expired
summary: Clears [$13F3] and erases the balloon sprite (tail call, returns from CODE_019F9B).

BalloonActive.name: P-balloon: control and position
summary: Switches to data bank 2, runs ControlSprCarried (controller input and speed), restores the bank, positions the sprite at Mario
and hides its OAM tile (Y = $F0) since the balloon is drawn as part of Mario.

NotCarryingBalloon.name: Carried sprite: interaction and release
summary: Resets interaction variables (CODE_019140). A Mario animation (not in a pipe) drops the sprite as stunned. Otherwise, if sprites are locked,
only positions it; else runs per-sprite checks, sprite-vs-sprite interaction and releases it when the Y/X button ($40) is not held.

ReleaseSprCarried.name: Release carried sprite
summary: Sets status 9 (stunned), then chooses: up held = toss up, sprite < $15 kicks unless down held, sprite >= $15 kicks if left/right held,
otherwise drops it at Mario X +/- 13 with X speed Mario +/- 4 and Y speed 0. Ends at StartKickPose.

TossUpSprCarried.name: Toss carried sprite upward
summary: Plays kick sound and smoke, sprite Y speed = -112, X speed = Mario X speed / 2. Falls to StartKickPose.

KickSprCarried.name: Kick carried sprite
summary: Plays kick sound and smoke, status = $0A (kicked), X speed from ShellSpeedX indexed by direction (+2 on Yoshi),
plus half Mario X speed when both move the same way.

StartKickPose.name: Start Mario kick pose and carry positioning
summary: $01A0A6: disables Mario contact with the sprite for 16 frames and shows the kick pose for 12 frames ([$149A]).
$01A0B1 (CODE_01A0B1): places a carried sprite at Mario using DATA_019F5B/61 X offsets and Y offset $0D ($0F when small, ducking or picking up),
and sets the carrying flags [$148F] and [$1470].

StunGoomba.name: Draw stunned Goomba
summary: Animates the upside-down Goomba (frame 0/1 every 8 frames, every 4 below timer 48 in [$1540]). At timer 8 on the ground it hops (Y speed -40).
Draws via SubSprGfx2Entry0 with A = $80 (Y flip).

StunMechaKoopa.name: Draw stunned Mecha Koopa
summary: Below timer 48 in [$1540], shakes it by toggling bit 0 of the screen X boundary during the draw. Carried: faces opposite Mario.

StunFish.name: Draw stunned Cheep Cheep
summary: Advances the animation, sets palette bit 7 and draws with SubSprGfx2Entry1.

StunThrowBlock.name: Draw grab block (blinking)
summary: Below timer $40 in [$1540], changes the palette every other frame (+2 mod $10) to blink, then draws like the Yoshi egg.

StunYoshiEgg.name: Draw Yoshi egg
summary: Draws one 16x16 tile via SubSprGfx2Entry1.

StunBomb.name: Draw stunned Bob-omb
summary: Draws a 16x16 tile, then overrides its tile with $CA.

StunKey.name: Draw key
summary: Faces opposite Mario if carried, draws a 16x16 tile, then overrides its tile with $EC.

StunPow.name: Draw P-switch
summary: By [$163E] (probably press timer): 0 draws tile $42, 1 finishes via CODE_019ACB, other values draw the squashed switch.

StunSpringBoard.name: Draw portable springboard
summary: Tail call to CODE_01E6F0.

StunBabyYoshi.name: Baby Yoshi: stunned/carried logic and draw
summary: Handles a carried or stationary baby Yoshi: looks for sprites to eat (CODE_02EA4E, [$160E] = slot of the item in the mouth, [$163E] eat timer),
hops when stunned, animates the eating (frames from DATA_01A35A) and moves the item into its mouth. A power-up ($74-$77) makes it grow into Yoshi
(sprite $35); other items count up in [$1570] and the fifth also grows it. Finally draws it and the item (CODE_02EA25).
Also contains the unused-looking branch for status $81 changing item.

s01A35A.name: Table: baby Yoshi eating frames
summary: $01A35A: frames by eat timer / 8. $01A361 and $01A363: unreferenced two-byte tables.
